tools.name: c64_program
tools.title: Runs PRG/CRT files, uploads BASIC or ASM, and coordinates batch test flows.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for program upload, execution, and batch workflows.

path.description: Path to the PRG image. Use an Ultimate-visible filesystem path on c64u, or a host-local filesystem path on VICE.

symbolsFile.description: Path to a VICE symbol file (.vs) to load alongside the PRG. Symbols are used by the disassemble tool when annotating addresses.

program.description: Commodore BASIC v2 program source to upload and run.

verify.description: Run post-execution polling to ensure the BASIC program executed without errors.

continueOnError.description: Continue running programs after assertion failure

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program before assertions

resetDelayMs.description: Delay after reset operations to allow the platform to settle.

messageTemplate.description: Greeting template. Use {PLATFORM}/{BACKEND} for uppercase or {platform}/{backend} for lowercase substitution.

captureScreenshot.description: Capture a framebuffer screenshot and save it as a PNG per backend.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for each greeting to appear on screen.

pollIntervalMs.description: Delay between screen polls while verifying the greeting.

inputSchema.description:
Program operations available via the c64_program tool.

Operations:
- load_prg: Load a PRG from Ultimate storage without executing it. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: symbolsFile.
- run_prg: Load and execute a PRG from Ultimate-visible storage on C64U/U64 or U2-family hardware, or from a host-local path on VICE. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: symbolsFile.
- run_crt: Mount and run a CRT cartridge image. Required inputs: path.
- upload_run_basic: Upload Commodore BASIC v2 source and execute it immediately. Required inputs: program. Optional inputs: verify.
- upload_run_asm: Assemble 6502/6510 source, upload the PRG, and execute it. Required inputs: program. Optional inputs: verify.
- batch_run: Run multiple PRG/CRT programs with post-run assertions. Required inputs: programs. Optional inputs: continueOnError, durationMs, outputPath, resetDelayMs.
- bundle_run: Capture screen, memory, and debug registers into an artifact bundle. Required inputs: runId, outputPath. Optional inputs: captureScreen, memoryRanges, captureDebugReg.
- cross_platform_greeting: Show a platform-customized greeting on one or more configured backends, capture screenshots, and verify the results. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: platforms, messageTemplate, verify, captureScreenshot, outputPath, restoreActiveBackend, timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs.

tools.name: c64_memory
tools.title: Reads or writes RAM, captures the screen, or waits for text matches in one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for memory I/O, screen reads, and screen polling.

address.description: Start address expressed as $HHHH, decimal, or a documented symbol name.

length.description: Number of bytes to read starting from the resolved address.

bytes.description: Hex byte sequence like $AABBCC or AA BB CC to write starting at the resolved address.

verify.description: When true, verify the write by reading before and after the change; Ultimate hardware also pauses during verification.

expected.description: Optional hex data expected before the write (verifies before writing).

mask.description: Optional verification mask (hex); only bits set in the mask are compared.

abortOnMismatch.description: Abort the write when the pre-write verification fails.

instructionCount.description: Stop after this many instructions (overrides length as a termination condition).

source.description: Source start address ($HHHH, decimal, or symbol).

startAddress.description: Start of search range ($HHHH, decimal, or symbol).

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path for the output file.

asPrg.description: Prepend a 2-byte little-endian load-address header (PRG format). Default: true.

inputSchema.description:
Memory operations available via the c64_memory tool.

Operations:
- read: Read a range of bytes and return a hex dump with address metadata. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length.
- write: Write a hexadecimal byte sequence into RAM. Required inputs: address, bytes. Optional inputs: verify, expected, mask, abortOnMismatch.
- read_screen: Return the current 40x25 text screen converted to ASCII. Required inputs: none.
- wait_for_text: Poll the screen until a substring or regex appears, or timeout elapses. Required inputs: pattern. Optional inputs: isRegex, caseInsensitive, timeoutMs, intervalMs.
- disassemble: Disassemble a memory region into annotated 6502/6510 instructions, including undocumented opcodes with canonical names. Symbol annotations from `.vs` files are applied when available. Works on C64U/U64, U2-family hardware, and VICE. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length, instructionCount.
- copy_memory: Copy a RAM region to another address. Required inputs: source, dest, length.
- fill_memory: Fill a memory range with a repeating byte pattern. Required inputs: address, length, pattern.
- search_memory: Search for a byte pattern within a memory range and return matching addresses. Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, pattern. Optional inputs: maxResults.
- compare_memory: Compare two memory regions byte-by-byte and report differences. Required inputs: address1, address2, length. Optional inputs: maxDiffs.
- save_memory: Dump a memory range to a local file, with an optional PRG load-address header. Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, filePath. Optional inputs: asPrg.

tools.name: c64_sound
tools.title: Adjusts SID registers, plays files, composes music, and runs verification captures.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for SID control, playback, composition, and analysis workflows.

count.description: Number of stereo sample pairs to capture.

encoding.description: Encoding used for the PCM sample payload.

volume.description: Desired SID master volume. Values outside 0-15 are clamped.

hard.description: If true, perform a hard register scrub; otherwise silence voices softly.

note.description: Musical note like A4, C#5, or Bb3. Overrides frequencyHz if provided.

frequencyHz.description: Explicit frequency in Hz. Used when note is omitted.

pulseWidth.description: Pulse width (0-4095). Used for pulse waveform.

verify.description: When true, record audio after silencing to confirm the SID output is quiet.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the SID, PRG, or audio file.

songnr.description: Song number within the SID file (0-based index).

root.description: Root note for the arpeggio such as C4 or A#3.

preset.description: Optional musical preset to influence timing/expression.

sidwave.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object.

cpg.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object.

format.description: Source format hint when providing raw text.

dryRun.description: When true, skip playback and only return compilation metadata.

analysisDurationSeconds.description: Length of the verification recording on analyzable backends.

waitBeforeCaptureMs.description: Delay between starting playback and beginning verification capture.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

expectedSidwave.description: Optional expected SIDWAVE used to refine analysis comparisons.

verifySilenceBefore.description: Run silence verification before playback to ensure a quiet baseline.

verifySilenceAfter.description: Run silence verification after playback to ensure voices are released.

silenceDurationSeconds.description: Audio capture length used for silence verification.

silenceRmsThreshold.description: RMS threshold applied to silence verification captures.

postSilenceWaitMs.description: Delay between main analysis capture and the post-playback silence check (milliseconds).

silenceWaitMs.description: Delay between silencing the SID and recording during pre/post checks (milliseconds).

request.description: Natural language user request describing the verification goal.

inputSchema.description:
Sound operations available via the c64_sound tool.

Operations:
- capture_samples: Capture raw stereo PCM samples from the C64 Ultimate audio UDP stream. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: count, encoding.
- set_volume: Set the SID master volume register at $D418 (0-15). Required inputs: volume.
- reset: Soft or hard reset of SID registers to clear glitches. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: hard.
- note_on: Trigger a SID voice with configurable waveform, ADSR, and pitch. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: voice, note, frequencyHz, system, waveform, pulseWidth, attack, decay, sustain, release.
- note_off: Release a SID voice by clearing its gate bit. Required inputs: voice.
- silence_all: Silence all SID voices with optional audio verification. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: verify.
- play_sid_file: Play a SID file stored on the Ultimate filesystem. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: songnr.
- play_mod_file: Play a MOD tracker module via the Ultimate SID player. Required inputs: path.
- generate: Generate a lightweight SID arpeggio playback sequence. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: root, pattern, steps, tempoMs, waveform, preset.
- compile_play: Compile SIDWAVE or CPG source and optionally play it immediately. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, format, output, dryRun.
- play_preset: Compile and play a built-in SID preset such as Für Elise by Beethoven. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: preset, platforms, verify, analysisDurationSeconds, waitBeforeCaptureMs, restoreActiveBackend.
- pipeline: Compile a SIDWAVE score, play it, and analyze the recording. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, output, waitBeforeCaptureMs, analysisDurationSeconds, expectedSidwave, verifySilenceBefore, verifySilenceAfter, silenceDurationSeconds, silenceRmsThreshold, postSilenceWaitMs, silenceWaitMs.
- analyze: Automatically analyze SID playback when verification is requested. Required inputs: request. Optional inputs: durationSeconds, expectedSidwave.
- record_analyze: Record audio for a fixed duration and return SID analysis metrics. Required inputs: durationSeconds. Optional inputs: expectedSidwave.

tools.name: c64_system
tools.title: Manages machine state (pause, reset, power) and schedules recurring background tasks.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for power, reset, menu, and background task control.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of iterations (omit for indefinite)

includeTimeline.description: Include the tail of the event timeline.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of span and timeline entries to return.

inputSchema.description:
System operations available via the c64_system tool.

Operations:
- pause: Pause the machine until resumed. Required inputs: none.
- resume: Resume CPU execution after a pause. Required inputs: none.
- reset: Issue a soft reset without cutting power. Required inputs: none.
- reboot: Trigger a firmware reboot to recover from faults. Required inputs: none.
- poweroff: Request a controlled shutdown via the Ultimate firmware. Required inputs: none.
- power_cycle: Return the active backend to a fresh state. C64U/U64 Tool Menu verification requires machine:menu_screen (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+); U2-family reboots through REST. Required inputs: none.
- menu: Toggle the Ultimate menu button for navigation. Required inputs: none.
- read_menu_screen: Read the active Ultimate menu's raw character and colour matrix through machine:menu_screen (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64/U2 3.15+). Required inputs: none.
- start_task: Start a named background task that runs on an interval. Required inputs: name, operation. Optional inputs: arguments, intervalMs, maxIterations.
- stop_task: Stop a specific background task and clear its timer. Required inputs: name.
- stop_all_tasks: Stop every running background task and persist state. Required inputs: none.
- list_tasks: List known background tasks with status metadata. Required inputs: none.
- performance_report: Summarize diagnostics spans and tool latencies from the current or latest MCP session. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: scope, includeTimeline, maxEntries.

tools.name: c64_debug
tools.title: Manage breakpoints, inspect registers, and step through code on the VICE backend.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for VICE debugger operations (breakpoints, registers, stepping).

enabled.description: Whether the checkpoint is enabled (default true).

items.description: Selects a register by id or name.

expectedPC.description: Target PC address to wait for (e.g. $0810).

inputSchema.description:
Available debugger operations.

Operations:
- list_checkpoints: List all active VICE checkpoints (breakpoints). Required inputs: none.
- get_checkpoint: Fetch a single checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id.
- create_checkpoint: Create a new checkpoint (breakpoint) in VICE. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: endAddress, stopOnHit, enabled, temporary, label, operations, memspace.
- delete_checkpoint: Remove a checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id.
- toggle_checkpoint: Enable or disable a checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id, enabled.
- set_condition: Attach a conditional expression to a checkpoint. Required inputs: id, expression.
- list_registers: List available registers (metadata). Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: memspace.
- get_registers: Read register values, optionally filtered by name or id. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: memspace, registers.
- set_registers: Write register values. Required inputs: writes. Optional inputs: memspace.
- step: Single-step CPU execution. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: count, mode.

tools.description: Cross-platform PETSCII typing plus native Ultimate keyboard and joystick events.

inputSchema.description:
Input operations: write_text, key, keyboard, joystick, release_all, state.

Operations:
- write_text: Send a text string to the keyboard buffer, with PETSCII token expansion. Required inputs: text. Optional inputs: delayMs.
- key: Tap a single key or hold it for a duration. Required inputs: key. Optional inputs: durationMs, count.
- joystick: Simulate joystick input. On C64U/U64 this uses machine:input (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+); VICE writes CIA1 registers. Required inputs: port, controls, action. Optional inputs: durationMs.
- keyboard: Send physical C64 keyboard matrix events through machine:input (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+). Required inputs: inputs, transition.
- release_all: Release every key and joystick control injected through machine:input (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+). Required inputs: none.
- state: Read the keys and joystick controls held through machine:input (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+). Required inputs: none.

workflowHints: Use write_text with {RETURN} tokens to automate BASIC entry; use key for one PETSCII/KERNAL queue key. Neither is for navigating Ultimate firmware menus.
write_text and key inject through the KERNAL keyboard queue ($0277/$00C6) so they work on both C64U and VICE.

Use keyboard for physical C64 key combinations (including modifiers) on machine:input, and release_all to recover from interrupted holds. It requires a C64U firmware version that provides the endpoint, or U64 3.15+.
Before native input, read c64://platform/status. If machine:input is unavailable or unknown, use key or write_text for ordinary C64 input instead of attempting physical matrix events.

Change C64U/U64/U2 configuration through c64_config REST operations, never by keyboard menu navigation. Use keyboard navigation only where REST has no equivalent, such as the machine code monitor, visual SID editor, or Tool Menu.
Joystick uses machine:input on a C64U firmware version that provides the endpoint or U64 3.15+; VICE supports up/down/left/right/fire through its monitor.
